reason: Changes are scoped to the AzureAI Search module (deployment/recipe serialization format change to a new AzureAISearchIndexInfo model, minor display driver and settings fixes) and don't touch core CMS pipelines, though the deployment/recipe JSON shape change could break existing recipes referencing raw AzureAISearchIndexSettings fields that are no longer serialized the same way.
